svg.title: Evidence beyond the headline
svg.desc: CONNECTION CHECK · CLIENT STUDY 13 additional clients completed a real Vexen read call Installed clients requested a note and received the expected record. Linux, Vexen 0.2.5; mostly scripted drivers. Checks connections, not coding improvement. PUBLISHED FAILURE · FILE HINT STUDY 10 repos. A failed gate. 1,874 held-out file queries Our file-hint method lost to simple history counts in every repository. File hints remain research-only. This study did not measure coding success.
